It originally aired from September 22, 1987, to May 23, 1995, with a total of eight seasons consisting of 192 episodes.. While never a critical success, the series was consistently in the Nielsen Top 30 (from season two onward) and continues to have an audience in syndicated reruns, and is also aired internationally.[2][self-published source?] One of the producers, Dennis Rinsler, called the show "The Brady Bunch of the 1990s".[3] For actor Dave Coulier, the show represented a "G-rated dysfunctional family".[4].
